# Alibaba.com

> > Alibaba.com is the world's largest B2B marketplace connecting global manufacturers, suppliers, exporters, and importers with Trade Assurance buyer protection.

Founded in 1999, Alibaba.com serves as the primary platform of Alibaba Group for wholesale trade, offering order protection through Trade Assurance, supplier verification, and comprehensive buyer/seller tools. The platform connects businesses primarily between China, USA, Europe, and emerging markets.

## Key Topics

- B2B Marketplace
- Trade Assurance
- Buyer Protection
- Manufacturers & Suppliers
- Wholesale Trading
- Order Tracking
- Supplier Verification
- Refund Policy
- Global Exporters & Importers
- Payment Security
- Shipping Guarantees
- Business Identity Verification
- My Alibaba Account
- Mobile App
- Fraud Dispute Resolution

- [About Alibaba.com](https://activities.alibaba.com/alibaba/introductory.php): Introduction guide covering memberships and platform basics for new users
- [Alibaba.com Download](https://app.alibaba.com): Mobile app download page for Alibaba.com with order tracking features

## Trade Assurance & Buyer Protection

- [Trade Assurance protects your Alibaba.com orders](https://buyer.alibaba.com/page/tradeassurance/buyer/story.html): Trade Assurance buyer protection program with quality/shipping guarantees
- [Trade Assurance protects your Alibaba.com orders](https://tradeassurance.alibaba.com/ta/VideosResources.htm): Video tutorials for Trade Assurance refund policy and Easy Return process
- [Safety & Security Center - Fraud & Dispute Rules](https://activities.alibaba.com/alibaba/safe-security-center-fraud-dispute-rules.php): Fraud dispute resolution rules and complaint submission procedures

## Selling on Alibaba

- [Start selling your products to global buyers on Alibaba.com](https://us.alibaba.com): Seller onboarding page for US suppliers to join Alibaba.com marketplace

- [Wholesale help](https://activities.alibaba.com/alibaba/wholesale-guide.php): Wholesaler program guide for small/midsize buyers ordering branded products
